precision.note: 60 bulk samples, 5 cell types, 4 programs, 800 genes, 20M reads per sample, 200 warmup + 100 draws, 1 chain. In float32 the rounding error of the log-likelihood (~1e6-1e7 in size) forces NUTS to a tiny step size, so the sampler barely moves even at the 1023-step cap. float64 restores a normal step size. On the small calibration problem (benchmarks/calibration) float64 gave the same accuracy at 1.9x wall time, so use it for large real datasets.
